params.name: LOCUST 2076
params.note: CONCEPT, generated by scripts/shapes/concepts/locust-2076.mjs (edit that, not this). The Locust fifty years on, after the Pyka Pelican Spray and the DJI Agras swarms: an electric hopper mothership on the AT-802's lines. A slab-sided hopper with hazard bands, a blank label plate and a sight strip; a tall glass cockpit set high behind it; a big slow six-blade prop on an electric motor nacelle with cheek inlets, a chin scoop and flank louvres where the PT6 stacks were; ten quad-rotor spray drones docked in lit cradles along the top of the wing, which fly out in a line off each wingtip while she sprays (the spray channel); a battery pack under the belly with cooling louvres and a charge strip; a faired spray boom with fourteen nozzles a side on an electric pump; a chin lidar and a terrain-following pod; the wire-strike kit; spring gear on fat tyres. A variant of the locust mesh, worn as the LOCUST 2076 factory edition.

parts.name: fuselage
parts.note: The shell. Glass, frames, the hopper lid, the hazard bands and the seams are separate parts laid a hair proud of it.
